## trove-design

> Designer skills: Figma review, accessibility, design systems

| Skill | What it does | Triggers | Paths |
|-------|--------------|----------|-------|
| **trove-a11y** | Accessibility checking skill for web and mobile interfaces. Auto-activates on UI component files. Checks WCAG compliance and ARIA patterns. | `accessibility check`, `a11y review`, `wcag compliance`, `aria patterns` | `**/*.tsx`, `**/*.jsx`, `**/*.vue`, `**/*.html` |
| **trove-component-spec** | Generate component specifications from design requirements. Produces structured specs with props, states, interactions, and accessibility requirements. | `component spec`, `design spec`, `component requirements` | — |
| **trove-design-review** | Design review skill for evaluating UI/UX implementations against design specs. Checks visual fidelity, interaction patterns, and design system compliance. | `design review`, `review the design`, `visual fidelity check` | — |
| **trove-visual-parity** | Achieve pixel-exact UI equivalence between two implementations via image diff. Establish a baseline harness first, migrate one component at a time, verify each with a screenshot diff within a tuned threshold. Use when migrating a styling system or matching a new implementation (e.g. React) to an existing one (e.g. Vue). | `match this design exactly`, `visual parity`, `pixel-perfect migration` | — |
